name: get_status
title: Get status
description: Describe the game state as text: open screen, position, facing, targeted block or entity, health, inventory, whether cheats are enabled, and recent chat.

name: get_blocks
title: Get blocks
description: List the blocks in a box between two corners (inclusive), as the player's game has them loaded, grouped by block state in command syntax. Air is only counted. Consecutive blocks along the x axis are merged into runs like "2..6 75 0". At most 4096 positions per call; query a single block by passing the same corner twice.

to.description: The opposite corner as [x, y, z].

name: get_entities
title: Get entities
description: List entities (mobs, animals, dropped items, players, vehicles...) near the player, nearest first, with position, distance and health.

name: screenshot
title: Take screenshot
description: Capture the game window as an image, along with a short status summary. By default the HUD (hotbar, chat, crosshair) is left out so the world is unobstructed; an open menu, inventory or chat screen is always shown. Cursor coordinates used by the input tool are pixels in this image.

name: run_command
title: Run command
description: Run a Minecraft command as the player and return its output. Needs cheats (Allow Commands) to be enabled in the world; otherwise it fails immediately, and get_status says whether commands are available. Use /help or /help <command> to discover commands and their syntax.

command.description: The command, with or without the leading slash, e.g. "/locate structure minecraft:jungle_pyramid".

name: input
title: Send input
description:
Perform a sequence of keyboard and mouse actions as the player, in order, then return a status summary and (by default) a screenshot. Each action takes at least one game tick (1/20 s); key presses, holds and waits take as many ticks as they say. A sequence can take at most 1200 ticks.

Action types:
- press {key}: press and release a key or mouse button. Combine modifiers with +, e.g. "left.control+a" or "left.shift+mouse.left".
- hold {key, ticks}: hold a key (or + combination) down for the given ticks, e.g. walking forward with w.
- key_down {key} / key_up {key}: press or release a key and leave it that way across actions, e.g. to keep sprinting.
- click {x, y, button}: move the cursor to (x, y) in screenshot pixels, then click. button is left (default), right or middle. Without x and y, clicks where the cursor is (in the world: attack/use).
- move {x, y}: move the cursor without clicking; with a mouse button held down this drags.
- scroll {amount}: scroll the mouse wheel; positive scrolls up.
- type {text}: type text into the focused text field (chat, signs, books, search boxes).
- look {yaw, pitch}: face an absolute direction in degrees; either may be left out to keep the current value.
- look_at {x, y, z}: face a point in the world. To aim at the middle of a block face, add 0.5 to the block coordinates and then move 0.5 toward the face, e.g. the top of block 3 64 7 is 3.5 65 7.5.
- wait {ticks}: do nothing for the given ticks.

Key names: letters and digits, space, enter, escape, tab, backspace, left.shift, left.control, left.alt, up, down, left, right, f1-f12, and mouse.left, mouse.right, mouse.middle.

screenshot.description: Whether to include a screenshot (without the HUD) taken after the actions.
